title: Build RunsPage with workflow run list, filtering, and pagination
description:
RunsPage.tsx is a stub (`
Runs
`). Build the full workflow runs list page. **Implementation:** - Use `useWorkflows()` or add `useRuns()` hook to fetch from `GET /api/v1/workflow-runs` - Table with columns: Run ID, Workflow Name, Status (RunStatusBadge), Steps (completed/total), Duration, Started At - Add status filter (pending/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled) - Add pagination (cursor-based, matching JobsPage pattern) - Click row navigates to `/runs/:id` (RunDetailPage already exists) - Loading skeleton rows, error and empty states **Patterns:** Follow JobsPage structure (cursor stack, limit selector, filter bar). **Files:** `dashboard/src/pages/RunsPage.tsx`, optionally `dashboard/src/hooks/useWorkflows.ts`
definitionOfDone: RunsPage shows workflow run list in table format

implementationPlan.description: Rewrite dashboard/src/pages/RunsPage.tsx. Use `useRecentRuns()` from hooks/useStatus.ts (or add `useRuns(filters)` to hooks/useWorkflows.ts fetching GET /api/v1/workflow-runs with query params). Table with columns: Run ID (truncated, monospace, link to /runs/:id), Workflow Name, Status (RunStatusBadge), Steps (completed/total as 'N/M'), Duration (formatted), Started At (relative time). Add status filter dropdown above table: All, Pending, Running, Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled. Cursor-based pagination: Newer/Older buttons, limit selector (10/25/50), cursor stack pattern matching JobsPage. Loading skeleton rows (8). Error state with retry. Empty state ('No workflow runs found').
implementationPlan.note: Full rewrite from stub. Uses useAllRuns() hook (already existed in useWorkflows.ts) with cursor-based pagination. Table: Run ID (truncated mono), Workflow ID, Status (RunStatusBadge), Steps (completed/total), Duration (computed from timestamps), Started (relative time). Status filter buttons (All/Pending/Running/Succeeded/Failed/Cancelled). Cursor stack pagination with limit selector. Loading skeleton, error, empty states. Click row navigates to /runs/:id.
